party.directive.guard.title: Guard
party.directive.guard.subtitle: Intercept attacks against Layla.
party.directive.follow.title: Follow
party.directive.follow.subtitle: Stay close to Layla and travel with the party.
party.directive.patrol.title: Patrol

conversion.encircled: The {actor} shudders, its surface brightening. It turns toward you, no longer hostile.
conversion.encircled_follows: The {actor} is pulled through the ring and falls in beside you.
item.used: Warmth spreads from the {item}. You feel mended.
item.date-flatbread.used: You break the warm date flatbread and eat. Sweet dates and roasted sesame fill you with warmth.
item.leaf-paste.used: You press the leaf paste into your wounds. It goes warm and green, and the hurt eases.
item.bitter-moss.used: You press the bitter moss into your wounds. The herbs bite, then settle warm.
item.sensory-enhancer.used: You swallow the sensory enhancer capsule. A sudden jolt of crystalline clarity surges through your mind — the static in your interface clears, and the Citadel map reveals the courtyard and surrounding fortress halls in sharp detail.
conversion.ring: The {actor} lowers its head and falls in behind you. You watch for a moment, then turn to go.
shaman.defeat: The shaman sinks back against the cold stone, its staff clattering loose across the floor. A dry, rattling breath escapes its chest — not of pain, but of profound, exhausted relief. Its milky eye stares into the dark ceiling.
shaman.defeat_line: Cold at last. The void drinks clean... But do not flatter yourself, stranger. The dead do not stay here. The hand that drew these caverns will wipe the slate and set the pieces back upon their squares. When the board resets, we will wake again... and so will you.
shaman.reveal: The chamber falls still. At the shaman's back, where its staff lay, a seam in the cave floor grinds open and a rough stair descends into a soft, phosphorescent glow. The first cave is yours.
shaman.memory: For a moment the settling dust hangs still, and in the quiet you understand: the chalk in your hand and the chalk rings holding the golems are the same thing — lines. A life you almost forgot rises up to meet you: the weight of a smooth stone, the grid of a Go board beneath your hands, and a voice that taught you that capture is just surrounding. Someone in this cave learned the same lesson, once, and built it into stone. The memory is gone almost as soon as it comes. But you know now how to read this board. You have played it before.
king.defeated: The elf king sinks to one knee, leaning his weight against the living root of his throne. He looks up at you with calm, sorrowful eyes, dark sap-like blood staining his lips.
king.speech: You fight like a piece that has tasted the board before, yet you do not know whose hand commands the game. There is an old story in the roots of this forest: far below our canopies, in the deepest vault of this world, lives the dark lord. It was the dark lord who laid the laws of every chamber, bound the stone, and shaped the dark. Even if you cut your path through every level of this kingdom, you cannot escape the night — you are only marching toward its court.
king.aftermath: He bows his head. The forest holds its breath. Then, one by one, the other elves lower their weapons and step back. No ring binds them — they simply choose to let you pass. You feel their eyes on you a long moment, and you lower your own blade.
item.scroll_read.learned: The dry bark is cool in your hand. The spiral unrolls behind your eyes, exact as a dictated rule: drain — take the strength of what stands within the circle and hold it until it holds nothing at all. The lines settle into your hand. You know the drain sigil.
item.spawn_scroll_read.learned: The fire-cured bark is cool against your palm. The amber circle resolves into a dictated rule: spawn — call one creature into the empty space. What answers, and how strong it stands, depends on the strength of the hand that draws it. The lines settle into your hand. You know the shape.
item.take_nothing: You see nothing loose on the floor to pick up here.
item.take_not_here: You don't see that on the ground here.
item.takedenied: The {label} is firmly anchored to the floor; you cannot pry it loose.
item.drop_nothing: Your pack is already empty; you have nothing to drop.
item.drop_not_have: You aren't carrying that in your pack.
item.drop_equipped: You are wearing that right now. Unequip it before setting it down.

error.command_blocked_by_progress: You have already taken care of {labels}.
error.cannot_command_here: You cannot do that from here. You must be in {room}.
error.missing_item: You need the {label} to do that.
error.nothing_to_consume: There is nothing consumable here for you to use.
error.no_actor_to_serve: There is no one here to give that to.
error.no_actor_to_listen: There is no one here listening.
error.no_target: There is no one in the room to target.
error.trace_mark_exists: A trace mark is already drawn in this spot.
error.no_craftable_available: You do not have any new trace patterns unlocked to draw.
combat.no_effect: The {kind} passes over the {actor} like wind over stone. No damage is done.
elemental.release: The fire elemental does not fall — it lets go. Its fire unknots, loosens, and the spiral in its chest unwinds like a long-held breath. It is released back to the elemental realm, and the board is suddenly, quietly cool. You stand at the edge of the pit and let it go.
elemental.charmed: The fire elemental does not fight. The spiral in its chest slows, and the heat pouring off it banks down to something you could stand beside. It turns to you, patient as ever, and the ring of basins stops burning. The board is quietly cool, and the way down is open.
conversion.fire: The {actor} flickers once, then settles at a low, steady glow. It turns to you, no longer afraid, no longer opposed. You hold still in the drift of its warmth.
equipment.chisel-axe.equipped: You wrap your hand around the chisel-axe, balancing the flat of the blade the way the goblins do.
equipment.chisel-axe.unequipped: You loosen your grip on the chisel-axe and stow it.
equipment.shaman-ring.equipped: You slide the shaman's ring onto your finger; the bone and clay warm against your skin.
equipment.shaman-ring.unequipped: You pull the shaman's ring off and tuck it away. The warmth fades.
equipment.item_not_held: You don't have {item} in your pack.
equipment.ambiguous_item: More than one item matches '{item}'. Be more specific.

handler.descend.deep_wood.text: Floor two. A glowing wood under a cave — because a quiet, well-lit walkable warp would have been far too considerate. Keep the chalk ring hand ready; I'll keep the sarcasm mild.

handler.descend.the_board.text: Floor three. The actual board. Whatever the elf king left standing, I'd rather not hear it called "the final boss" — it's a dish of black glass holding the ring together. Mind the ember near the south store.

handler.minimap_unlocked.text: Signal's clear. Looks like taking out the shaman cleared the interference on the surveyor feed. I've patched the floor grid into your console — check your sidebar, you've got a live minimap now. Try not to walk in circles.

floor4.arrival.the_village: You step off the last stair into gaslight and the smell of bread. Warm stone rings under your boots, worn pale in a path from the stairs down to a low iron hearth. Somebody has raked ash over a pair of small boots by the hearthstones and gone off to do something else. Up ahead, past the steam pipes, an iron bulkhead seals off the entire north side of the village, and two soldiers stand in front of it not moving at all. Somewhere behind the terraces a cart wheel grinds over a grate, and somebody calls a number out loud and gets it wrong.

handler.descend.the_village.text: Floor four. Wait — my console is picking up civilian life signs. Actual people live down here? In this dump? Keep your weapons low; let's see what the locals have to say before you go swinging.

handler.first_mob_killed.text: There it is. First one down, no help, no clever speech — just the job. I've left your own vitals on the readout now. Consider it a refresher, since you clearly needed one.

handler.first_mob_charmed.text: Oh, now that's a first. You didn't kill it, you walked up and closed a ring around it. Handlers are supposed to discourage improvisation, so naturally I've patched ally tracking into your console. Stop looking smug.

handler.clean_shaman_reward.text: The shaman's down and I have no idea how many golems are still standing down here — which means you actually did it. Clean. I'm upgrading nothing, don't get excited. Consider the readout a professional courtesy between operators.

handler.sensory_enhancer_unlocked.text: That's a Citadel-issue perception capsule. Either someone down there grew a conscience, or you charmed it out of one — either way, take it. I can already see the feed improving from up here, so the map's about to show you more than walls.

bastion.entry_scene: You step through the reinforced archway into the command bastion. Heavy steam vents hiss along the vaulted granite ceiling. Ahead, standing over a brass tactical map table, Captain Malik and Priest Harun are locked in a venomous exchange, oblivious to your entrance.
harun.bastion_entry: The transport cart sits idle on the gantry, Malik. The temple's patience is not infinite. Where is the offering? If your soldiers cannot secure a single boy, the high priests will find a commander who can.
malik.bastion_entry: Hold your tongue, priest! My sentries were killed when the steam line blew. There is an infiltrator loose in the complex, sabotaging valves, and you prattle about your holy offerings while my fortress burns—
bastion.doors_slam: A loose bolt clatters under your boot. Both men freeze and whip around toward the threshold. Behind you, massive iron security blast doors drop from the vaulted ceiling with a deafening SLAM, pneumatic deadbolts punching into the granite. The exits are sealed shut.
malik.bastion_alert: The infiltrator! Draw steel, Harun—nobody leaves this bastion alive!
malik.defeat: Captain Malik falls to one knee, steam hissing wildly from his cracked brass cuirass. He drops his saber with a clatter, panting heavily, before collapsing unconscious. Behind him, the heavy hydraulic deadbolts on the blast doors unlock with a concussive hiss.
priest_harun.defeat: Priest Harun's incense censer drops and shatters into burning embers. His scarlet robes scorch as his litany breaks apart into a dying gasp.
priest_harun.defeat_line: You think you saved the boy? The machine feeds on their minds, wretch! Upstairs... the converters... they hollow them out, strip their names, and mold them into pawns for the dark lord's board!
item.teleport_scroll_read.learned: You unroll the brass-leaf scroll and study the sharp, intersecting triangles etched in its surface. A pulse of pale geometric light flares into your eyes — you have learned the Teleportation Sigil.
sigil.spawned: The amber sigil erupts in golden sparks! A {actor} manifests from the swirling fire and falls into rank behind you. (HP: {hp}, STR: {strength}, INT: {intelligence})
sigil.spawn_limit: The air crackles with spent heat, but no flame takes hold. You cannot sustain more than {max} summoned sprites at once.
magic.insufficient_mp: You do not have enough magic to trace the {item}. (Requires {mp_cost} MP, you have {mp} MP)
zayd.freed_speech: You... you unlocked it! You're really here to save me? Please, let's get out of here before the guards come back!
einar.freed_speech: Thank you... we thought we would freeze in those iron bars. Take this sensory enhancer capsule — I managed to keep it hidden in my sleeve. Back in the High Sanctuary, we synthesized it to heighten human senses and expand spatial perception. Swallow it, and it will reveal where your allies stand and where active portals hum through the citadel's stone.

handler.zayd_freed_warning.text: Layla. That offering was cleared on the manifest. Let the offering ship. That's the job.

zayd.return_safe: The Elder makes it no further than his own doorway. He sinks into a chair with one hand over his mouth and cannot get a word out. Zayd stands beside him, small and filthy, and after a moment pats the old man's shoulder the way an adult would. Then the boy turns back to you, fishing a dented brass lamp from under his coat.
zayd.lantern_speech: I... I'm sorry I don't have anything valuable to give you as a reward for saving me. But here—this was my dad's lantern from the lower drift. The glass never really goes cold, even near the frost vents. Please, take it with you... you'll need the light down there more than me.

handler.teleport_tutorial.text: Good. That sigil hooks your chalk to the anchor points. Powered platform? Permanent anchor, so those are free. Anywhere else you're down to three chalk anchors, and they burn out after a single teleport. Don't get comfortable with them.

handler.quest.teleport_scroll_complete.text: Signed off on the retrieval. Whatever that sigil was keeping locked is behind you now—I'm not asking what you found inside it, and I'd advise you not to volunteer. Floor's below you. I've got your back down there.

handler.quest.free_prisoners_complete.text: Cage count reads zero. Every one of them breathing, which was nowhere on my forecast, so I'm revising my estimate of you upward. That's three doors now instead of two. Wouldn't call it breathing room.

civilian.breach_warning.text: Center breach. They have a line to {actor}. Clear every siege soldier from the teleport pad in {minutes} minutes or we lose them.

civilian.breach_cleared.text: Center is clear. Civilian countdown canceled.

civilian.reward.salt_reach: Nivi presses a soapstone-and-brass seal into your hand. Salt Reach appears on the teleport map.
civilian.reward.glassbank: Eliška gives you a cobalt glass prism. Glassbank appears on the teleport map.
civilian.reward.woolcross: Amaru ties a copper routing knot around your wrist. Woolcross appears on the teleport map.
civilian.reward.greenrest: Abeni gives you a green enamel routing seed. Greenrest appears on the teleport map.
civilian.reward.brass_yard: Chen Yu-xin gives you a toothed brass routing gear. Brass Yard appears on the teleport map.
civilian.reward.six_town_accord: All five routes answer at once. Together with Deepwell, the worker towns form the Six-Town Accord.
siege.frost_wolf_rout: The Frost-Wolf soldiers falter as their command signal dies. {count} raiders break formation and retreat into the northern estate.
siege.iron_ram_rout: Steam vents from abandoned Iron-Ram armor as the command signal cuts out. {count} maulers turn back toward the bastion.
siege.frost_leopard_rout: The Frost-Leopard hunters lower their weapons when the mirror signal goes dark. {count} hunters vanish back through the southwest doors.

handler.quest.save_zayd_complete.text: Zayd is off my board and inside your reach, which is a sentence I would rather not have had to write. That file's closed. I won't ask what it cost—you'll hand me a charming half-truth and change the subject.

handler.quest.awaken_jamil_complete.text: The shell's quiet and the voice inside it belongs to a man again. Objective un-flagged. I'm not going to discuss the rest of that with you—some lines read better quiet. Take a minute. You've earned one.

sigil.chalk_anchor_placed: You draw the double triangle on the stone. The chalk glows with a soft light, anchoring this room.
platform.activated: As you finish tracing the double triangle, blue light flares through the brass conduits. The platform roars to life with ancient power, opening the descent to Floor 5!
transformation.wake.intro: The warmth of high wisdom stirs deep within {actor_name}. The fog in their mind shatters.
transformation.wake.reveal: {actor_name} remembers who they are: {actor_name} is now {woken_name}.
item.sensory_enhancer.consumed: You swallow the translucent blue capsule. An electric chill shoots through your veins, clearing the static behind your eyes. Your senses sharpen with startling clarity: you can feel where your allies breathe through the stone, and the hum of active teleport portals burns bright against your inner map.
transformation.secret_passages.revealed: As the frost-bind shatters from their mind, a gasp echoes through the high hall. Ancient counterweights shudder in the stone as hidden seals slide open, revealing the Citadel's secret perimeter ring connecting the three throne rooms!
